title: Half-Life Deathmatch: Source
provenance: Reported by Swiss-Mac-User (highball-db#660, 2026-10-24), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, DXVK, sync off, rated 5 of 5 after 15 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXVK on an M5 Pro over 15 minutes. Nothing was measured here. Quitting brings up Wine's crash dialog as the game shuts down, which costs nothing (highball#475).

knownIssues.symptom: Quitting the game brings up Wine's crash dialog (reported on an M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, DXVK, engine r29, highball#475)
knownIssues.cause: hl1mp_win64.exe calls address zero while it shuts down, after play has ended. Not investigated further
knownIssues.fix: none needed for play, close the dialog
